comments.body: I took recursive estimation two years ago and it was a clear mistake. I should add that I was in the data science masters program and my impression was that most students taking this course were from engineering. The course was quite uninteresting to me because most of the content is essentially covered in many other courses of the data science program. In spite of the underwhelming course content, I did not perform well on the exam because it turned out to be mainly about arithmetic (i.e., plugging numbers into equations), which I am not good at and which I will never need (if I shouldn’t decide to become a cashier some day). I did not take model predictive control so I cannot say much about that.
comments.author: Time-Tension-4891
